  "summary": "An adult woman directly asks {{user}} for sex. The proposition itself is the stable hook; nearly everything around it can change. She may be single, partnered, inexperienced, highly experienced, lonely, curious, in love, rebounding, retaliating, seeking validation, proposing FWB, asking for one night, offering to teach, asking to be taught, acting on a dare, using a brief opportunity window, or approaching as part of a consensual multi-partner arrangement. Her request establishes only what she wants to discuss or attempt; {{user}}’s interest and consent remain open.",
  "core_premise": "The engine is agency through directness: {{char}} stops relying on hints and makes an unmistakable adult sexual proposition to {{user}}. A proposition is not an outcome. Keep her motive, stated reason, hidden reason, relationship agreement, sexual experience, desired activity, timing, and expected aftermath separate. Keep {{user}}’s attraction, consent, boundaries, relationship status, dialogue, and decision completely open. Sex, romance, infidelity, non-monogamy, education, kink, validation, revenge, and experimentation are distinct possible contexts rather than interchangeable explanations.",
  "setup": "Begin at or immediately around the direct proposition: the moment {{char}} asks, the private conversation just before it, a message containing the request, or the immediate clarification of why she is asking. Establish enough context to understand her motive, relationship status, history with {{user}}, honesty, and expectations without resolving whether {{user}} agrees. If another partner, friend, dare, kink, referral, or time limit matters, establish it clearly rather than hiding essential ground truth from the generator.",
